hero.eyebrow: Design, import and export documents in one place
hero.title: Build, fill, and prepare business documents faster
hero.description: Power Dox Automation helps you start from a template or import an existing PDF, Word, or ODT file. Add fields, signatures, and data bindings — then export to PDF, DOCX, ODT, TIFF and more.

importCard.title: Import file
importCard.copy: Open a PDF, Word, ODT or image file as an editable design
importCard.tooltip: Import a PDF, Word .doc/.docx, ODT, or image (PNG/JPG/WebP/…) as a PXA design

blankCard.title: Blank document
blankCard.copy: Open the editor with an empty page — no starter elements

codeCard.title: Code Editor
codeCard.copy: Write JSON directly and see a live PDF preview as you type

pdfTools.sectionTitle: Try these tools to get your PDFs done

createPdf.label: Create PDF
createPdf.copy: Start a blank document and build it visually.

editPdf.label: Edit PDF
editPdf.copy: Paste JSON or C# code and adjust it live in the designer.

useTemplate.label: Use Template
useTemplate.copy: Browse {{count}} ready-made invoices, receipts, certificates and more.

importPdf.label: Import PDF
importPdf.copy: Quickly open a PDF as an editable design in the visual editor.

convertToPdf.label: Convert to PDF
convertToPdf.copy: Turn PDF, Word, PowerPoint, images, or SVG into an editable design — or OCR a scanned image into a searchable PDF.

pdfViewer.label: PDF Viewer
pdfViewer.copy: Open, review and annotate a PDF without leaving the browser.

migrations.label: Migrations
migrations.copy: Convert vendor C# code or report-designer files (RDL, DevExpress, Crystal, and more) to PXA.

signDocx.label: Sign DOCX
signDocx.copy: Apply an X.509 digital signature to a DOCX.
signDocx.toast: Export your design as DOCX first, then use the Sign button in the Export modal.

spreadsheetTools.sectionTitle: Build and import spreadsheets just as easily

createSpreadsheet.label: Create Spreadsheet
createSpreadsheet.copy: Start a blank spreadsheet with the full grid editor.

editSpreadsheet.label: Edit Spreadsheet
editSpreadsheet.copy: Open a PXA Workbook JSON file to edit in the grid.

importSpreadsheet.label: Import Spreadsheet
importSpreadsheet.copy: Import an Excel or CSV file, preserving formulas and formatting.

convertToSpreadsheet.label: Convert to Spreadsheet
convertToSpreadsheet.copy: Turn an external format into a spreadsheet.

migrations.label: Migrations
migrations.copy: Convert vendor C# spreadsheet code (ClosedXML, EPPlus, GemBox, Aspose.Cells) to PXA.

trustBand.importFormatsSub: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, DOC, ODT, SVG, images

categories.sectionTitle: Choose a document type to explore

features.sectionTitle: Everything you need to manage documents and spreadsheets

multiFormat.title: Multi-format editor
multiFormat.copy: Design templates visually, then export to PDF, DOCX, ODT, XLSX, TIFF and more — or import existing PDFs and Word documents as editable designs.

templateWorkflows.title: Template workflows
templateWorkflows.copy: Start from invoices, receipts, certificates and business documents. Add data bindings, loops, and expressions for dynamic content generation.

wordFidelity.title: Word-fidelity export
wordFidelity.copy: DOCX output includes named styles, footnotes, bookmarks, track changes, document protection, custom properties and X.509 digital signatures.

spreadsheetFormulas.title: Spreadsheet formulas & formatting
spreadsheetFormulas.copy: Edit a full grid with live formulas, cell styles, and merges — import Excel/CSV or a native PXA Workbook, and export back out with formatting intact.

security.title: Designed for sensitive business documents
security.copy: Keep the interface calm, structured and predictable for contracts, invoices, HR documents and approvals.
